Container.Name: solar-dashboard
Container.Overview:
A simple solar dashboard for a Fronius inverter with a smart meter. Big green/amber/red cards say whether the washing machine and dryer can run on spare solar right now, based on live readings, a Solcast forecast and the TasNetworks Tariff 93 peak times. A history page tracks peak grid use, solar generation and value against the same period last year.
The solar forecast is read from evcc (which already fetches Solcast), so it uses none of your Solcast account's free daily API calls. Direct Solcast is available in Settings if you don't run evcc. Default settings PIN: 0000.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds config.json and the SQLite history database.

Config.Name: Inverter address
Config.Description: IP or hostname of the Fronius inverter (Solar API). Leave blank to set it in the web UI.

Config.Name: evcc address
Config.Description: evcc base URL. The dashboard reads evcc's solar forecast from it, so it needs no Solcast calls of its own.

Config.Name: Solcast API key
Config.Description: Only if you don't use evcc. Shares your Solcast account's ~10 calls a day.

Config.Name: Solcast site ID
Config.Description: Only if you don't use evcc.

Config.Name: Settings PIN
Config.Description: Optional. Overrides the PIN set in the web UI (default 0000).
